topic: Pinned runtime identity and scrubbed environment
Last expression controls status, not every expression
script:
let 0; printf 'zero=%s
' "$?"; let 1; printf 'one=%s
' "$?"; let -1; printf 'negative=%s
' "$?"; let 0 2; printf 'last-positive=%s
' "$?"; let 2 0; printf 'last-zero=%s
' "$?"

topic: Help and option-looking literal
No argv joining; quoting and blanks
script: value=4; let 'value = 7'; printf 'quoted=%s;value=%s\n' "$?" "$value"; let value = 8; printf 'split=%s;value=%s\n' "$?" "$value"

topic: Sequential operands and prefix/postfix writes

Within-operand syntax failure side effects
Runtime division failure after committed writes
Lazy operators and conditional branch
Integer bases, signed overflow, division edge, masked shifts
Power associativity and unary precedence
Readonly assignment with RHS side effect
script: readonly locked=1; side=0; tail=0; let 'locked=(side=5)' 'tail=9'; printf 'status=%s;locked=%s;side=%s;tail=%s\n' "$?" "$locked" "$side" "$tail"

topic: Readonly increment and compound assignment
script: readonly locked=1; let 'locked++'; printf 'postfix=%s;locked=%s\n' "$?" "$locked"; let 'locked+=2'; printf 'compound=%s;locked=%s\n' "$?" "$locked"

topic: Temporary environment prefix versus unrelated persistent writes

' "$value"; }; work; let() { printf 'shadow
'; return 7; }; let 1; printf 'shadow-status=%s
' "$?"; command let 'value+=1'; printf 'builtin-status=%s;outer=%s
' "$?" "$value"

topic: Recursive variable arithmetic and recursion rejection
script: value='other+2'; other=3; let 'result=value'; printf 'resolved=%s;result=%s\n' "$?" "$result"; value=value; let value; printf 'recursive=%s;continued\n' "$?"

topic: Native arrays characterize explicitly excluded surface

script: set -- -ab; getopts ab option; printf 'first=%s;index=%s\n' "$option" "$OPTIND"; let 'OPTIND=1'; getopts ab option; printf 'second=%s;index=%s\n' "$option" "$OPTIND"

topic: Right-associative assignment, compound operators, unset zero

script: set -o posix; readonly locked=1; let 'locked=2'; printf 'status=%s;locked=%s;continued\n' "$?" "$locked"
